_comment: COPY this file to trainers.local.json (same folder) and fill in REAL data. trainers.local.json is git-ignored and must NEVER be committed. department must be one of: agriculture, applied_science, computing_informatics, building_civil, business_liberal, electromechanical, hospitality. role defaults to 'trainer'; use 'hod' for a head of department. defaultPassword is used when a trainer has no explicit password.
